title: Oil of Slipperiness
summary: Unobtainable potion gives Freedom of Movement until Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action, self. Difficult terrain, spells and magical effects cannot slow your movement. Immune to Paralysis and Restrained until Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
